calendarFaqs.q: When does CUSD start school in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Capistrano Unified starts the 2028–29 school year on Tuesday, August 15, 2028. It is a minimum day for elementary and middle school students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD Winter Recess, and when does school resume?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs December 25, 2028, through January 5, 2029. School resumes Monday, January 8.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CUSD Spring Recess in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Recess runs Monday, April 2, through Friday, April 6, 2029. School resumes Monday, April 9.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CUSD in 2029?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 31, 2029. CUSD lists it as a minimum day for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: Which CUSD dates are minimum days or pupil-free days?
calendarFaqs.a: November 1 and December 22 are K–12 pupil-free days. Minimum-day schedules include August 15 for elementary and middle school students, elementary conference windows November 2–7 and February 26–March 1, high school final-exam windows December 19–21 and May 25–31, and May 31 for all students. Weekends and Memorial Day within a district window are not student attendance days. Check the assigned school for exact dismissal times.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CUSD observe Veterans Day in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: CUSD lists Friday, November 10, 2028, as the Veterans Day holiday. Veterans Day falls on Saturday, November 11.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I get the official CUSD 2028–29 PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link in Downloads. The source is the CUSD calendar Board approved April 22, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Can I add the CUSD calendar to Google Calendar or Apple Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. MySchoolDates provides a one-time ICS file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook. It does not sync with later district changes, so confirm updates with CUSD.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2027–28
whatsNew.subtitle: Student dates and CUSD schedule details that differ from the prior school year.
content: School starts August 15, one day earlier than the August 16 opening in 2027–28.
The last student day is May 31, one day earlier than June 1 in 2027–28.
Thanksgiving week runs November 20–24, compared with November 22–26 in 2027–28.
Winter Recess moves to December 25–January 5, and students return January 8 instead of January 3.
CUSD observes Veterans Day on Friday, November 10; the calendar does not list a separate November 12 recess like 2027–28.
The middle, elementary, and high school Back-to-School Night windows each move two calendar days earlier.
The second K–12 pupil-free day is December 22 instead of December 17.

sourceReviewDetails: CUSD's calendars page identifies the 2028–29 calendar as Board approved April 22, 2026; it is not labeled revised.
The calendar lists November 1 and December 22 as K–12 pupil-free days and uses “Minimum Day” for shortened student schedules.
The elementary conference window November 2–7 crosses a weekend, and the high school final-exam window May 25–31 includes a weekend and Memorial Day on May 28.
School-level dismissal times, Back-to-School Night dates, graduation details, and later changes should be confirmed with CUSD or the assigned school.
